subject: Re: NovaHealth MSA - limited recourse & evidence escrow option
messages:
From: Emily Zhang <emily.zhang@novahealth.com>
To: Marissa Cole <marissa.cole@redwood.com>
Cc: procurement@novahealth.com, Legal - NovaHealth <legal@novahealth.com>
Date: 2025-08-27T09:14:00-07:00
Subject: NovaHealth MSA - IP carve / escrow proposal

Hi Marissa,

Thanks for sending the MSA redline. Our legal team did a pass and there are two sticking points we need to resolve before procurement can move forward:

1) Scope of the indemnity for third-party IP claims. We need Redwood to accept responsibility where infringement arises from Redwood-delivered model outputs (including any embeddings or generated artifacts) provided to NovaHealth under normal usage.

2) Evidence & remediation / escrow: because this is a health care deployment, we need a clear evidence checklist and an escrow amount that NovaHealth can draw against for customer remediation costs if disputed claims delay an acceptable remediation window.

I've attached our annotated redline and a short note from our counsel. Samir (copied) may follow up with a formal demand structure.

Can your team confirm whether Redwood will accept limited recourse tied to demonstrated model-origin claims and what process you propose for notice, preservation, and escrow draws?

Appreciate a prompt reply — procurement is aiming to have terms agreed this week.

Thanks,
Emily
Emily Zhang
Head of Procurement, NovaHealth
emily.zhang@novahealth.com
+1 415-555-0128

Attachments: NH-MSA-client-redline-v3.docx, counsel-note.pdf

From: Marissa Cole <marissa.cole@redwood.com>
To: Emily Zhang <emily.zhang@novahealth.com>
Cc: Kimberly Park <kimberly.park@redwood.com>, Ben Carter <ben.carter@redwood.com>
Date: 2025-08-27T13:02:00-07:00
Subject: Re: NovaHealth MSA - IP carve / escrow proposal

Emily — thanks for the clear summary and the redline. Kim and Ben are copied for legal and commercial input. High level response and our proposed path forward below.

1) Limited recourse model: Redwood is willing to accept responsibility for third-party IP claims that are directly traceable to model outputs generated by Redwood-hosted models running under your account and prompts (i.e., not customer-supplied content or downstream modifications). We propose tying our indemnity to a demonstrable provenance test (logs + model hash + sample output match).

2) Escrow & evidence: to avoid open-ended exposure, we propose an evidence checklist (attached) and a capped escrow-style remediation reserve equivalent to 6 months of committed spend or a fixed dollar cap (proposed: $250k) — whichever is lower. The escrow would be drawn only for validated remediation expenses per the checklist.

I've attached Redwood's proposal (redwood-limited-recourse-proposal.pdf) and an evidence-notice-checklist.pdf to make this concrete. Key asks for NovaHealth: agree the provenance criteria and accept the proposed cap or suggest an alternative.

If that looks acceptable, Ben can prepare a short addendum for the order form and Kim will circulate the legal redline. We can also do a 30-minute call with Samir to iron out notice and timing.

Best,
Marissa Cole

Subject: Fwd: NH MSA redline - escrow terms (redline attached)

FYI Marissa — attaching the legal team's suggested edits. High level: NovaHealth will accept a limited recourse approach only if the following are in the MSA or order form:

- A firm definition of "Redwood-origin outputs" tied to model ID, timestamped request logs, and content hashes.
- Immediate notice requirement (48 hours) upon suspected third-party claim and a 14-day preservation window for logs.
- Escrow draw triggers to include (a) court-ordered remediation, (b) regulator-ordered action, or (c) independently-validated customer remediation costs.
- Proposed escrow quantum: $500k for initial term; NovaHealth willing to reduce to $300k if Redwood accepts an earlier indemnity review after 12 months of production.

We've annotated your proposal and included alternative language where Redwood defense control is conditional on model provenance. See attached: NH-MSA-client-redline-v3.docx (legal_redline_comments).

On scheduling: Emily can do a short call tomorrow afternoon.

--Samir
